description: This file defines the DeviceConnectionService interface, which includes methods for managing and retrieving information about device connections, specifically setting and getting the last known gateway for a device.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionService
classes.description: Interface for service managing device connection information, such as last known gateways.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last gateway that acted on behalf of the specified device, handling success or failure via the provided result handler.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last gateway that acted on behalf of the specified device, if set, via the provided result handler.
